lines.l: The morning light is turning blue, the feeling is bizarre
The night is almost over, I still don't know where you are
The shadows, yeah, they keep me pretty like a movie star
The daylight makes me feel like Dracula
In the end, I hope it's you and me
In the darkness, I would never leave
You won't ever see me in the light of day
I'm on the verge of getting it
I run back to the dark
Shut up, Jenny, just get in the car
I just wanna be right where you are
In the end, I hope it's you and me
In the darkness, I will never leave
It's hardest moment coming from afar
Come pull up in my spot
Let's keep the night glowing, I don't ever wanna stop
Got my knee to glow, sky is turning blue
Let it clear, the slow, the lips ain't on
The wind pace is about to blow
So run from the sunlight Dracula
